title: Branching and commit conventions
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. 0016 is a development convention filed under workflow, and its temporary dev branch has become the standing integration branch.
decision: Branching and commit hygiene are project conventions stated in the repository's working conventions: a feature branch per cut or change, merged into dev by pull request; dev merged into main by pull request for release; commit only your own paths, by name; never amend or rewrite shared history.
consequences: Filed in the development context, where it belongs.
